top_headlines.headline: Meta stock tumbles on report of potential equity raise
top_headlines.summary: Investing.com full account of META -7% on equity raise report; capex $145B this year; Susan Li and Dina Powell McCormick leading discussions; no banks hired yet.

top_headlines.headline: Meta stock sinks 6% on report of stock sale
top_headlines.summary: META stock fell 6%+ on equity raise report, highlighting investor unease about the scale of capital demands needed to fund Meta's $145B AI infrastructure plans.

top_headlines.headline: META Stock Drops Nearly 7% In Afternoon Trading  Heres Whats Driving The Selloff
top_headlines.summary: META dropped ~7% as details emerge of Susan Li and Dina Powell McCormick exploring massive equity raise, with premium AI subscription 'Hatch' possibly $199.99/month.

top_headlines.headline: Meta Enters Enterprise AI With Business Agent
top_headlines.summary: META rose 2.80% intraday on Business Agent launch at Conversations conference, with 1M+ businesses using it and integration with Shopify, Zendesk validating enterprise AI monetization.

top_headlines.headline: EU Orders Meta to Open WhatsApp to Rival AI ChatbotsMeta Calls It 'Regulatory Overreach'
top_headlines.summary: EU ordered Meta to give rival AI chatbots free WhatsApp access within 5 days or face 10% global revenue fine, severely threatening Meta's control over WhatsApp's AI ecosystem.
